messages:
Rae: Quick sync: proposing a staged regional rollout for feature X (model routing + variant). Goal: minimize cold-starts, honor tenant opt-outs, and have clear fallback chains. Need ops + SRE signoff.

Dev-Nav: Outline pls: slices, prechecks, rollback triggers, and how Dedicated orgs opt-out.

Rae: Plan sketch:
- Shadow 6h global to collect perf and errors
- Slice 1: 0.5% tenants in a low-traffic region for 2h
- Slice 2: 2% in two regions with overlapping 50% windows for 6h
- Slice 3: 10% spread with A/B control for 12h
- Gradual ramp by +10% every 3h after slices if metrics stable
Dedicated orgs: default OFF, org-level override only after account-ops approval.

SRE-Bob: Auto rollback triggers I propose:
- p99 generation latency > 200ms for 5m
- 5xx rate > 0.6% for 5m
- token-cost per request delta > +25% for 10m
- hallucination-rate spike > baseline + 3 sigma
Circuit breakers: per-node queue > 150 or GPU mem > 88% for 3m -> throttle slice and failover. Sticky fallback 300s.

Dev-Nav: Fallback chain: primary -> quantized-compatible -> stable-v2. If fallback fires, sticky for 300s. If same tenant has >3 fallbacks in 30m, block for 24h and page oncall. Also add rapid-global-halt: >4 slice failures across regions in 30m -> global halt and sticky fallback for 1h.

Rae: Flag schema ops to support (example): {flag: "feature_x_rollout", scope: "tenant", tenants: ["acme"], pct: 0.5, regions: ["ap-south"], org_override: false, region_constraint: null, requires_kms: false} - note this is a single-line example in the playbook.

Dev-Nav: Pre-slice checks: no tenant in slice should have blackout windows or region constraints. Run priming 10m before slice: ./scripts/prime --tenant T --model X --samples 300. Propagate denylist to routers within 30s. Also run synthetic probes 5m before start.

SRE-Bob: Dashboards/alerts: per-tenant p95/p99, token-cost, fallback-count, routing-consistency probe every 60s. Alert: correlated spike across latency+cost+fallback -> P1. Auto-ticket to #incidents on rollback triggers.

Rae: A/B measurement: ab-runner --control stable --variant feature_x --min-samples 2500 --metrics latency,cost,hallucination_rate. Require >95% data completeness. Use rolling windows overlapping by 50% to smooth cold starts.

Dev-Nav: Ops action items: implement flag API + org_override flow, ledger entries for priming and flag changes. SRE action: alerts + runbook stub. Product: schedule 30m shiproom once PRs linked.

ops-bot: feature-flags v4.1 promoted to staging at 2026-08-01T09:00Z :white_check_mark:

Rae: Thanks team. Add any legal/enterprise constraints (KMS/data residency) now; otherwise I'll draft final playbook and invite shiproom. :calendar:
